references.text: The parable of the vineyard owner and his sons reflects the parable of the vineyard owner who sends servants and finally his son in Mark 12:2
God's people, represented by the vineyard, and how they treat God's messengers, have parallels to Mark 12:2
The parable of the vineyard owners that Jesus tells in Matthew has direct parallels to Mark 12:2
The parable of the vineyard owner found in Luke resembles the story told in Mark 12:2
